blocks.text: Standard deviation (SD) yeh naapti hai ke data mean (ausat) ke ird gird kitna bikhra (dispersed) hua hai. Kam (chhoti) standard deviation ka matlab hai ke qeematein mean ke qareeb ghani jama hain; zyada (bari) standard deviation ka matlab hai ke qeematein door door tak phaili hain. Agar standard deviation sifar (zero) ke qareeb ho to tamam qeematein mean ke bohat qareeb hain; bari standard deviation ka matlab hai ke qeematein mean se door tak phaili hain.

blocks.alt: Do surkh ghanti numa (bell-shaped) curves. Curve (a) chaura aur neecha, curve (b) tang aur ooncha. Har aik mein hari lakeer chooti par mean (mu) dikhati hai aur doosri hari lakeer aik standard deviation (sigma) door; un ke darmiyan sigma ka do-rukha teer. Neeche: a) phaila hua curve, zyada standard deviation; b) mean ke gird ghana curve, kam standard deviation.
blocks.caption: Normal curves: (a) zyada phaila, zyada standard deviation; (b) mean ke gird ghana, kam standard deviation (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Dono curves mein σ (sigma) ka teer dekhein: (a) mein mean se aik SD ka faasla bara hai, is liye data door tak phaila hai aur curve chaura aur neecha hai; (b) mein yeh faasla chhota hai, is liye qeematein mean ke qareeb jama hain aur curve tang aur ooncha hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Biology mein standard deviation aam taur par naap (measurements) ka farq (variability) jaanchne ke liye istemal hoti hai, jaise paudon ki growth rate, kisi sample mein enzymes ki miqdar (concentration), ya koi bhi doosra biological data.
